query: I just got back from walking my dog this morning, he chased a squirrel all around the community park and even knocked over a kid’s bubble machine, I felt so bad I bought the little one a new pack of bubble refills on the way home. Oh and I also tried that new matcha croissant from the bakery downstairs, it’s way too sweet for my taste, I don’t think I’ll get it again. Anyway, I need to cancel two of my pending orders, the first one is #W8367380 and I’m canceling it because I ordered it by mistake, the second one is #W1242543 and the reason for cancellation is that I no longer need it.
